summary:
- Issue: [gc_read_region.go:349](/tmp/wago-gc-read-call-facts/src/core/compiler/backend/railshot/amd64/gc_read_region.go:349) replaces the full `inlineTargetTable`. This drops `gcReadOnly`, which was set at [compile.go:1968](/tmp/wago-gc-read-call-facts/src/core/compiler/backend/railshot/amd64/compile.go:1968).

  This happens when the module has no normal inline target but has a GC read-region target. The fixture has this shape. The `$peek` target causes the replacement, so the proven `$walk` summary is lost. Both planning and emission then reject the call. This explains the observed reuse count of 2 instead of 3.

No concrete safety, trap-order, rooting, or moving-GC issue found in the static review. I did not run tests or builds.
